Status: Wave 273 accepted (6.3): the HawkNET byte/value utility Class431

Method.evidence: Every row read from its own IL through NameCandidates --inspect-methods. One coherent block: the HawkNET byte/value utility Class431, whose named siblings already fix the convention (IntegerValueToByteArray, SerialNumberByteArrayToValue, FormatObjectSize, FormatHex, CompareAsValues, Dump). The free members are the bit extraction helpers (GetHighByte/GetLowByte, GetHighUInt16/GetLowUInt16, GetHighUInt32/GetLowUInt32), their combiners (MakeUInt16/UInt32/UInt64), the four endian-explicit readers (ReadBigEndianUInt16/UInt32, ReadLittleEndianUInt16/UInt32 - the byte order verified from the ldelem order against the combiner), the byte-range extractor, the priority formatter and the second Dump overload.
Method.themes: A type whose named siblings show the convention settles its free members from their own bodies alone: shift/mask pairs become GetHigh/GetLow, the combiners become MakeX, and the endian readers are told apart by which byte lands in the high half. This is the coherent-block method of the previous wave applied to a utility class, and it names 16 rows in one pass.
